_comment_logs: Each entry watches one log file. When an appended line matches a rule's `match` regex (case-insensitive, first match wins), the pet reacts with that rule's status (running|done|error|idle). `agent` is the label shown on the status card. Use FORWARD slashes in paths (e.g. C:/Users/you/agent.log) — they work on Windows and need no escaping. Remove `_example: true` to activate an entry.
